title: Warm Crispy Moroccan Little Gem Lettuce Chebakia
description: A quick-fix Moroccan dish featuring little gem lettuce and chebakia, this recipe is a perfect snack for any occasion, with a grassy flavor and shattering texture.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the all purpose flour, semolina flour, yeast, and salt.
Gradually add the olive oil and water to the bowl, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a few leaves of little gem lettuce in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the lettuce to form a triangle or a square shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Heat about 1-2 inches of olive oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Fry the chebakia until they are golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Drain the chebakia on paper towels and sprinkle with sesame seeds and paprika.
